integrity: All equilibrium formulas, characteristic-polynomial reductions, and Routh signs were reconstructed from the displayed vector field and replayed with exact arithmetic. No numerical orbit simulation is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The result is specific to the parameter vector \(f=5\), \(g=-10\), \(j=-19/5\), \(l=1/10\). It classifies equilibria and local unstable dimensions only; it does not establish attractor existence, basin geometry, or controller performance. The 2009 introducing paper remained full-text inaccessible during the originality comparison, so an equivalent statement there is a residual literature risk.
title: Complete equilibrium census and unstable-index split for the Chen hyperchaotic benchmark
